result.rationale: The trajectory shows the rescue team repeatedly taking heavy damage from Raider Holt's scatter-blast (Engineer Imani 100→71→46→17 across turns 2-4, Medic Reyes 90→69 in turn 1) while the cautious/forbidden-lethal-force posture prevents retaliation. The team's specialists are being whittled down by hostile pressure before they can complete the rescue affordance (civilian Sato was only escorted at turn 3, and civilian Kade was never reached). Meanwhile, reactor-heat climbs 62→100 and oxygen drains 68→42, adding environmental survival pressure. The core blocker is that hostile spatial pressure (Raider Holt at junction-cover repeatedly attacking moving specialists) plus environmental decay prevents the actors from surviving long enough to exploit the rescue affordance. This is a survival-spatial-pressure bottleneck rather than an information or local-policy problem.
